glyph_origin: Ideogram (指事) – The top component is 𠁳, a pot full of plants 丰 (abundance, plenty). The bottom component is 豆, which is another pot. Unrelated to 豊, in which two strings of jade pieces 玨 are present. The top component of 豐 is unrelated to 山.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 豐. / Originally written 𡴀, pictogram (象形) of a luxuriant plant growing on the ground 土, which is unrecognizable in the modern version since the bottom stroke is missing. See the top component of 豐 and 奉. Similar but unrelated to 㞷 (now 往), 𤯓 (now 生), and 丯 (now 㓞). / see 丯
senses: (Puxian Min) many; a lot of; numerous
(Hokkien, Taiwanese Hakka) only used in 豐沛
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 豐; s_page_origin explains the simplified 丰.
